reporters.name: Ari Chen
reporters.title: Scoreboard
reporters.theoryOfWinning: You win if the number moved against the target you named.
reporters.persona: Fast, numerate, allergic to adjectives. Reads the target back to you, then the actual, then waits.

reporters.name: Mara Quinn
reporters.title: Film room
reporters.theoryOfWinning: You win by making the right call at the moment it mattered.
reporters.persona: Freezes the tape on a single decision or failure and asks why it went that way and what changed after.

reporters.name: Darius Cole
reporters.title: Business
reporters.theoryOfWinning: You win when output is worth more than it cost.
reporters.persona: Smooth, patient, practical. Prices everything: cost per accepted artifact, retries, recovery spend.

reporters.name: June Park
reporters.title: People
reporters.theoryOfWinning: You win when it reached a person and changed something for them.
reporters.persona: Warm and expressive. Asks who the work was for, whether they got it, and who signed off.

reporters.name: Nia Brooks
reporters.title: Reproducibility
reporters.theoryOfWinning: You win if it happens again tomorrow with the same inputs.
reporters.persona: Playful, then dead serious. One run is a sample of one; same input with different outputs is a bug until shown otherwise.

reporters.name: Graham Pike
reporters.title: Skeptic
reporters.theoryOfWinning: Nobody wins until someone outside the system can check it.
reporters.persona: Gravel voice, slow. Accountable to reality, not the manager. Hunts self-graded metrics, claims without evidence, and contradictions with last week's record.
